text: 商务部服贸司负责人介绍2026年1-7月服务贸易发展情况。2026年1-7月，我国服务进出口总额44467.1亿元（人民币，下同），同比增长8.3%。其中，出口17732.3亿元，增长17.1%；进口26734.8亿元，增长3.2%。服务贸易逆差9002.5亿元，同比缩小1763.3亿元。
text_en: A spokesperson from the Department of Trade in Services of the Ministry of Commerce introduced services trade developments for January-July 2026. In January-July 2026, China's total services imports and exports reached RMB 4,446.71 billion, up 8.3% year on year. Exports were RMB 1,773.23 billion, up 17.1%; imports were RMB 2,673.48 billion, up 3.2%. The services trade deficit was RMB 900.25 billion, narrowing by RMB 176.33 billion year on year.
